_comment: The permission grant an unattended `claude -p "/kit:ship-ticket <n> unattended"` call runs under, invoked once per ticket by ship-startable.sh. Broader than tending-settings.json on purpose: tending only ever edits labels and merges an already-open PR, while shipping a ticket writes code, creates a worktree, commits, pushes, and opens the PR itself. A consuming project's own settings file merges its test and lint commands over this one before a run, the same split tending-settings.json uses — this file says what shipping a ticket may do in any repo; the project's file adds how it verifies the change before pushing. Deny beats allow in the merged result, so a project can widen this but cannot unlock anything refused here.
